title: Northern Virginia Compute Demand To Local Service
summary: Follow a concentrated data-center market through regional forecasts, rate rules, transmission, local standards, environmental permits, water service, construction, energization, and measured local outcomes.
current_state_summary: The corridor has named planning, rate, transmission, air-permit, and water rails, but no corridor-wide or customer-specific readiness conclusion.
current_state: JLARC supplies a dated concentration and load baseline rather than a current project ledger.
The GS-5 decision defines a future cost-allocation framework for very large loads without establishing customer service.
Golden-Mars has a state approval and unresolved local route condition.
Loudoun Phase 2 remains an active policy process with a post-September 2026 check.
DEQ and Loudoun Water expose named permit and service rails without proving built or operating outcomes.

dependency_stack.current_state: Legislative and regional planning records establish a large operating market and load-growth pressure.
dependency_stack.boundary: A market baseline or forecast is not a customer service commitment.

dependency_stack.current_state: GS-5, Loudoun policy, Golden-Mars, and DEQ permits create named regulatory trails.
dependency_stack.boundary: A rule, route approval, or permit is not completed infrastructure.

dependency_stack.current_state: The selected records do not establish final route delivery, customer energization, water connection, or facility operation.
dependency_stack.boundary: Construction and service require project-specific completion, acceptance, and metering.

dependency_stack.current_state: Cost, reliability, emissions, noise, water, workforce, and community outcomes remain incomplete.
dependency_stack.boundary: Scale requires measured and sustained outcomes, not announced demand.

evidence_limits: The pathway does not infer spare capacity from the size of the existing market.
GS-5 is not a customer agreement and Golden-Mars approval is not energization.
An air permit or reclaimed-water program does not establish facility operation or actual use.
next_records: Loudoun Phase 2 staff report, hearings, adopted text, and effective date.
Golden-Mars land decision, final route, construction, and energization.
Named customer service agreements, load, facilities, water allocations, permits, testing, and operating outcomes.
